senses.gloss: (it is) good, better. Tanḥ. B’har 1 חזר בו מ׳ if he amends, it is good.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 30a:9">Bets. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ שיהיו … ואל וכ׳</he> it is better that they fail unwittingly than &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:4">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>מ׳ דליעבדו וכ׳</he> it is better that they worship the golden calf (than commit murder).
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:12">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דאקום וכ׳</he> it is best that I get up and go to them myself; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the better, the right conduct. Lam. R. introd. (R. Abba 2) המאור … היה מחזירן למ׳ the light in it (the Law) would have led them back to the right way.
